{
  "name": "simpane",
  "displayName": "Sim Pane",
  "version": "0.1.3",
  "description": "Puts the iOS Simulator beside your Claude Code session: a live screenshot, dark mode and text size switches, your app's own logs, and tools that let Claude see the screen for itself.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Gary Riches",
    "url": "https://github.com/griches"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/griches/simpane",
  "repository": "https://github.com/griches/simpane",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/griches/simpane/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/griches/simpane#readme",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/griches/simpane#privacy",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ios",
    "simulator",
    "xcode",
    "swift",
    "swiftui",
    "screenshot",
    "simctl",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "refresh": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Live refresh, in seconds",
      "description": "How often the picture is retaken while the pane is on screen and Live is on. off: only on Refresh and after a command that changes the simulator.",
      "options": [
        "1",
        "2",
        "5",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "2"
    },
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open the pane",
      "description": "Open the pane when Claude installs, launches or builds for a booted simulator. Off: only on /simpane.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
